items.title: 1.2 Network architecture aur bunyadi tasawwurat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of network architecture and packets (PDF 7-8).

blocks.title: Network architecture
blocks.text: Network architecture computer network ka mukammal design hai: computers, servers aur doosre devices kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain, aur network par data kaise bheja jata hai.

Network architecture mein hardware, software aur baat-cheet ke qawaid (rules) shamil hain. Achhi architecture network ko kaamyabi se chalane mein madad deti aur aage barhane (expansion) mein sahara deti hai (Fig 1.2).

items: Bhejne ke liye data chhote hisson mein toota jata hai jinhein packets kehte hain.
Packets cables ya wireless signals se safar karte hain.
Network devices har packet ko sahi manzil tak rehnumai dete hain.
Wusool karne wala device packets ko jor kar asal data bana deta hai.

blocks.text: Yeh amal hamwaar aur tez baat-cheet mumkin banata hai: bohat se devices wahi links share kar sakte hain, aur gum shuda packet sab kuch dobara bheje baghair dobara bheja ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Devices ki tasaveer ya naam dekh kar har device ke naam ko us ke kaam se milayein; phir jawabon par guftagu karein.

blocks.prompt: Network architecture kya hai, aur is mein kaun si teen cheezein shamil hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh network ka mukammal design hai: devices kaise tarteeb diye gaye aur data kaise bheja jata hai. Is mein hardware, software aur baat-cheet ke qawaid shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Bhejne se pehle data packets mein kyun toota jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhote packets network ke links doosre traffic ke saath share kar sakte, har aik ko manzil tak rehnumai mil sakti, aur gum hone par alag se dobara bheje ja sakte hain; receiver unhein jor kar asal data bana deta hai.

items: Architecture: devices ki tarteeb aur data ka safar; hardware, software aur qawaid.
Data packets mein bheja aur receiver par jora jata hai.
